task.title: Downloading the X-Author Add-in: Designer + Runtime

step.cmd: Click on the Conga X-Author for Excel tab.
Click Download X-Author™ For Excel. This navigates you to the Conga community portal and enter your login credentials.
Go to Resources > Install Center on the community portal.
Under My Packages, select Conga X-Author for Excel.
In the Conga X-Author™ Enterprise Add-In: Designer + Runtime section, select the required version and click Download > Confirm Download. The executable installer is downloaded to your system.
